items.text: Built, shipped and operated a FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction platform that ran live for the entire tournament: 271 players across 48 country crews logged 21,506 match predictions and 37,712 daily-quiz answers across all 104 fixtures, driving 8.4k visitors and 94k page views.
Ran six concurrent game modes off one Postgres scoring engine: a recompute_scores() SQL function fired by a pg_cron heartbeat after each fixture sync pulled by a Deno Edge Function.
Enforced deadlines and prediction privacy in the database rather than the client, via Row Level Security and SECURITY DEFINER RPCs that hide crowd statistics until kickoff (anti-herding).
Worked around the absence of a paid live-sports API with a browser userscript that scraped in-play match pages and posted results into the app, scoring fantasy standings in real time mid-match.
Tech: React 19, React Router 7, Vite, Supabase (Postgres, RLS, Deno Edge Functions), Vercel.
Built a real-time React 18 + TypeScript (Vite 7) terminal that monitors live Fliq prediction markets and cross-references 1,000+ Polymarket assets to surface cross-platform arbitrage opportunities.
Integrated Gemini 1.5 Flash to semantically verify market pairings, plus category grouping, noise filtering and a payoff simulator.
Tech: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, REST APIs, Gemini API.

entries.title: Fliq-Arb and fliqr: High-Frequency Arbitrage Engine

items.text: Engineered a Python decision engine linking live Binance BTC/USDT prices (WebSocket) to Fliq prediction-market orderbooks, with a FastAPI monitoring dashboard and full trade telemetry.
Implemented VWAP-based entry pricing, a momentum-persistence guard against false breakouts, and competitor-bot detection via orderbook analysis.
Built fliqr, a Dockerized GitHub Actions cron service that continuously ingests newly listed markets.
Tech: Python, FastAPI, WebSockets, Docker, GitHub Actions.

Wrote a stdlib-only Python parser that decodes hand-cricket scorecards from unstructured WhatsApp exports, recovering 895 matches, 1,264 players and 38,000+ ball-by-ball events; resolved player identities across aliases and nicknames.
Shipped the analytics dashboard as a dependency-free single-file HTML app with phone-number masking in the public build.
Tech: Python (stdlib only), CSV data pipeline, single-file HTML/JS.

Rearchitected a safety app predicting railway level-crossing closures along a driver's route from live train positions, replacing the V1 Selenium scraper with the RailRadar REST API and implementing haversine route-to-gate matching and ETA-based gate-occupancy prediction.
Tech: React Native (Expo), TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, Google Maps API, Overpass API.
